name: gate-router
description: Map changed Git files to local verification commands

interface.shortDescription: Map changed Git files to local verification commands
interface.longDescription: Map changed Git files to local verification commands. Read NUL-delimited Git paths, reject bad refs and malformed rules, preserve filenames as argv, deduplicate overlapping file sets, and support standard CLI help/errors.
